facts.material: polyester weft-knit pile faux fur fabric permanently bonded to leather (weight/value split not stated)
facts.form: women's jacket made of a bonded leather/textile composite

gri_path: GRI 1: chapter 43 note on artificial fur excludes imitation fur obtained by knitting (heading 6001), so heading 4304 does not apply; the faux fur is a knit pile textile

GRI 1/GRI 2(b)/GRI 3(a): the jacket is prima facie classifiable in 4203 (leather apparel) and 6102 (knit women's coats of man-made fibers); each heading covers only part of the materials, so they are equally specific
GRI 3(b): composite good; the leather is presumed to give the essential character (usually the larger share of value and weight, as in NY J87560)
GRI 6: 4203.10.40 other leather apparel; coats and jackets; other; women's -> .60

rejected_alternatives.reason: women's knit MMF jacket; would apply if the polyester pile faux fur (e.g. as the outer surface) were found to give the essential character
artificial fur excludes knitted imitation fur of heading 6001
covers women's leather apparel other than coats and jackets

missing_facts: Which layer forms the outer surface of the jacket (leather or faux fur)?
Weight and value breakdown of leather vs. faux fur
classification.rationale: A jacket of knit polyester pile faux fur bonded to leather is a composite of a leather-apparel material (4203) and a knit textile (6102). The knitted imitation fur is not artificial fur of 4304. Under GRI 3(b), NY J87560 (in force) found leather gave the essential character of a women's jacket of leather bonded to knit faux sherpa, based on outer surface, weight and value, and classified it in 4203.10.4060. The same result is assumed here, but if the faux fur forms the outer surface and dominates, the jacket would go to 6102.30.20.10.
